title: BlueStar Wall Ovens Recalled by Prizer Painter Stove Works Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Some of the wall ovens have been improperly installed and/or have damaged flexible gas appliance connectors, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 940.

title: BRP Recalls Ski-Doo Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel pump inlet fitting can come into contact with the oil tank and break, leading to a fuel to leak, which poses a fire hazard. Units: About 10,200.

title: Mutsy USA Recalls EVO Strollers Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The opening between the grab bar and seat bottom of the stroller can allow an infant's body to pass through and become entrapped at the neck, posing a strangulation hazard to young children when a child is not harnessed. Units: About 340.

title: Play Yard Sheets Recalled by 4moms Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The sheets are too small for the play yards. A sheet that does not properly fit the play yard poses an entrapment hazard that could lead to suffocation. Units: About 1,440.

title: Progressive International Recalls Canning Jar Lifters Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The jar lifter handle can detach over time due to a missing stainless steel core in the hinge. This can cause the tongs to fail to grip and allow a jar being lifted to fall, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 22,700 in the U.S. and 3,800 in Canada.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel hose could separate from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1450.

title: Large Scented Candles Recalled by Barneys New York Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: These candles can burn with a high flame, presenting a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 40.

title: Electric Blower Vacuums Recalled by OWT Industries Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: Objects that are drawn into the unit during vacuum mode can break through the plastic housing, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 131,500.

title: Homelite Recalls Electric Blower Vacuums Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: Objects that are drawn into the unit during vacuum mode can break through the plastic housing, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 241,000 in the United States and 13,600 in Canada.

title: Cramer Recalls Folding Step Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The folding step stool can crack or break and collapse, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 6,500.

title: John Deere Recalls Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The oil filter can leak, posing a fire hazard. Pinholes or cracks have been identified in oil filters installed by the engine supplier which were not manufactured to specification. Units: About 4,700.

title: Purr-Fection Stuffed Animals with Flashlights Recalled by MJC Due to Laceration Hazard, Sold Exclusively at Cabela's
summary: LED flashlight wires can protrude through the stuffed toy, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 7,200.

title: Bohning Recalls Hunting Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard; Can Fire Unexpectedly
summary: The crossbow can fire unexpectedly when the auto-safety mechanism appears to be on and the trigger is pulled, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystanders. In addition, the crossbow limbs can crack or break under normal use. Units: About 150.

title: Samsonite Recalls Dual-Wattage Travel Converter Kits Due to Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: The converter can overheat if a load in excess of 50 watts is applied to the converter while in the 50-watt setting. This poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,000.

title: Balsam Hill Recalls Pre-lit Christmas Trees Due to Burn and Shock Hazards
summary: The remote control receiver box attached to the Christmas tree can overheat and melt, posing burn and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 700.

title: SlumberWorld Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 810.

title: Jerdon Style Recalls One-Cup Coffeemakers Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The coffeemaker can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Liberty Mountain Recalls Mountain Climbing Lanyards Due to Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The elastic webbing on the lanyards can deteriorate over time and break while in use, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the climber. Units: About 140.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Hello Kitty City Motor Scooters Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
summary: The scooters can accelerate suddenly while in use, causing the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 5,200.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Monster High City Motor Scooters Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The scooters can accelerate suddenly while in use, causing the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 5,500.

title: One World Technologies Recalls Ryobi Cordless Tool Battery Pack Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery pack can overheat and burst while on a charger, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 54,200 in the United States and 2,200 in Canada.
